items.summary:
Event Details

• Dates: 22–23 November 2026
• Time: 09:00 AM – 05:00 PM daily
• Location: Dhaka, Bangladesh
• Key Topics: Evidence-based implementation, worker protection, decent work, the Team Europe Initiative on Decent Work in Bangladesh, scientific paper presentations, and policy dialogues.
• Participants: Researchers, policymakers, academics, employers, workers' representatives, and ILO representatives.
